title: fix(spec): the save door reads ctx.text?.( as a literal text-key ask

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu19ctjaTjyM4gmWfgBPNRmc)_
Fixes #35512
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md and skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md already teach "an undeclared key is refused at save when asked for literally, else at run" without naming a call shape; this diff makes that sentence hold for the optional-call shape, so nothing new is taught. The one hand-written page that names the call shape, content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx (~499), now names `ctx.text?.('key')` beside `ctx.text('key')`

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感的作者面变化:写钩子或脚本动作的作者,用可选调用 `ctx.text?.(` 的写法去取一句没声明的文案时,保存时就被拒,以前要等运行时才报错。
- 属于"组织语言文案"那组工作:兑现钩子与动作文案字段已经写明的承诺,即按字面取的未声明文案在保存时就被拒。
- 若出错,受影响的是用 `ctx.text?.(` 写法取了未声明文案的钩子或动作,保存会被拒;声明那句文案即可通过,本改动可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `TEXT_CALL` in `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`, the one literal key reader behind both save doors (`HookSchema` at `hook.zod.ts` and `ActionSchema` at `action.zod.ts`, through `hookTextKeysAskedIn`), now also reads `ctx.text?.('k')`, awaited or not. So an undeclared key asked for in that shape is refused at save with the existing `undeclaredHookTextKeyAtSave` / `undeclaredActionTextKeyAtSave` sentence, at `body.source` (or `handler` for an in-process hook handler). The masking of comments and longer strings and the snake_case key group are unchanged.
- Shape decisions: whitespace or a line break around `?.` is read (`ctx.text ?. ('k')`), matching the reader's existing whitespace tolerance around the dot. The card's second shape, non-null `ctx.text!('k')`, is deliberately NOT read (patch round 1, L2 S1 on 7025732554): it is TypeScript with no JavaScript form. A handler's `!` is erased before the save reads `Function.prototype.toString()`, so `main` already reads it as the plain call; in a `js` body it is a syntax error (an action is refused as `action-body-does-not-compile`, a hook body never runs). So the card's `!(` ask is moot, and a pin documents why. `ctx?.text(` and `ctx!.text(` are left out: `ctx` is the bound parameter and is never optional in the type.
- The refusal sentence's echo stays `` (`ctx.text('k')`) ``. It names the call, not the spelling the author used, and it reads correctly for both read shapes (the plain call and `?.`). Its bytes, which tests pin, are unchanged.
- Rider (accepted L1 nit on PR #35510): the TSDoc that describes the literal-only save check now names the `?.(` shape. That covers `HookSchema.texts`, `HookContext.text`, `ActionSchema.texts`, the two internal docblocks beside the doors, and the header comments above `TEXT_CALL`. `.describe()` strings are unchanged.
- ADR-0087: a registered semantic entry, `hook-action-text-key-optional-call-refused`. The `narrowed` kind refuses `no-migration-prescription`, and there is no mechanical rewrite.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` (the kind is `narrowed`), with a BREAKING FROM/TO section and the fix.

## Tests

- Pins in `packages/spec/src/data/hook-texts.test.ts` and `packages/spec/src/ui/action-texts.test.ts`, one per shape (`ctx.text?.(`, `await ctx.text?.(`) for each door. A lit pin checks that an undeclared key is refused at `body.source` with the exact sentence. A dark pin checks that a declared key, and a computed key in that shape, still pass save. The hook file also has a reader pin for whitespace and a line break around `?.`, a `handler`-path pin (an inline handler asking `ctx.text?.('undeclared')` is refused at `handler`, the strict-TypeScript case; an action has no handler path), and a pin that `ctx.text!('k')` is not read, with the reason.
- On head 0acd17d2 both files are green (51/51).
- Ablation on head 0acd17d2: replacing the optional-call arm `text(?:\s*\?\.)?\s*\(` with the old `text\s*\(` (one occurrence) turned 8 of the 51 tests red. The restore was proved by an empty `git diff HEAD`. (The earlier 12-red-first and 13-red readings were taken on 269566b8, before patch round 1 removed the `!(` arm.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 859 files / 27461 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `ctx?.text(` and `ctx!.text(` are still not read at save (see above). If one of them is used with an undeclared key, the runtime refuses it when the code runs.
- A real producer of the new shape already exists in this tree with a declared key: `packages/spec/src/data/hook-context-text.test.ts:43` (`ctx.text?.('follow_up_subject', …)`), and it stays green. The runtime's own `ctx.text!(String(key), …)` in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` is host TypeScript, never a saved body. The break is the hook half only: `ActionSchema.texts` is unreleased (pending changeset), so the action half ships already narrowed (L2 N1).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/hook-texts.test.ts src/ui/action-texts.test.ts`, including the two `ctx.text?.(` shape rows per door and the handler pin.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`: the `TEXT_CALL` regex hunk (the `(?:\s*\?\.)?` arm) and its header comment on why `!` is not read.
2. `.changeset/35512-text-call-shapes.md`: the declarations and the BREAKING section.
3. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.hook-action-text-key-optional-call-refused.ts`.
